description.en: The region ID of the service.

description.zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见[ListServices ](~~412109~~)。
description.en: The service name. For more information about how to query the service name, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

description.zh:
服务更新类型，目前支持合并模式和替换模式。不传默认为合并模式。

- merge（合并模式）：若原服务配置JSON为
`{"a":"b"}`，更新配置为`{"c":"d"}` ，则合并模式下最终配置为`{"a":"b","c":"d"}`。
- replace（替换模式）：若原服务配置JSON为
`{"a":"b"}`，更新配置为`{"c":"d"}` ，则替换模式下最终配置为`{"c":"d"}`。
description.en:
The type of the service update. Valid values: merge and replace. By default, merge is used if you do not specify this parameter.

*   merge: If the JSON string configured for the existing service is `{"a":"b"}` and the JSON string specified in the body parameter is `{"c":"d"}`, the JSON string is `{"a":"b","c":"d"}` after the service update.
*   replace: If the JSON string configured for the existing service is `{"a":"b"}` and the JSON string specified in the body parameter is `{"c":"d"}`, the JSON string is `{"c":"d"}` after the service update.

description.zh: 更新配置。参数配置说明，请参见[CreateService](~~412086~~)。
description.en: The request body. The body includes the request parameters that you want to update. For more information about the request parameters, see [CreateService](~~412086~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas update-service --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --update-type merge --member-to-update example-string --biz-body name_:_foo_,_model_path_:_http://path/to/model.tar.gz_,_processor_:_tensorflow_cpu_,_metadata_:_instance_:_2,_memory_:_7000,_cpu_:_4 --region cn-hangzhou
